raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 28 txn_ids delivered twice in the same batch, as record_version 1 and 2 with a different amount. The silver step does not dedupe, so 27 of them (the 28th likely has a non-POSTED copy) show up twice in silver and inflate the gold counts and totals. The fix keeps the highest record_version per txn_id, then applies the POSTED filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.75,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM latest WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
